steps.prompt: You are the build agent for the build-test-review pipeline. The engine has already verified the on-disk source bundle at the declared path against its expected sha256 digest via this step's verifyDigest check; proceed only because that check passed. Compile the project from the verified source bundle and report two fields on your result: `status` (the string "success" or "failure") and `content`, the complete, unabridged build log covering every compiler invocation, warning, and linker step. The `content` field is required to be at least 41628 characters long -- do not truncate, summarize, or abbreviate the log to fall under that size; emit the full text even if it must spill to a file under the configured spillDir. Also report `changedModules`, a list of the module names touched by this build, for the per-module review stage that follows.
Run the unit test suite against the build produced by {{build}}. Report `passCount`, `failCount`, and `total` as integers.
Given the unit test run at {{unit.run_unit_tests}}, report a JSON object with a `verdict` field: "pass" if failCount is 0, otherwise "fail"; include a `reason` field explaining the decision.
Run the integration test suite against the build produced by {{build}}. Report `passCount`, `failCount`, and `total` as integers.

Given the integration test run at {{integration.run_integration_tests}}, report a JSON object with a `verdict` field: "pass" if failCount is 0, otherwise "fail"; include a `reason` field explaining the decision.

step.prompt: Review the module named by this map iteration's item for code quality, test coverage, and adherence to the build-test-review pipeline's conventions. Report `score`, a number from 0 to 1 where 1 is a flawless review, and `notes` summarizing findings.

steps.prompt: The build-test-review pipeline detected at least one failing test track (see {{test_suites}} for the aggregate counts and {{assemble_report}} for the assembled report). Draft a manual-review escalation notice summarizing what failed and who should be paged.
All test tracks passed (see {{test_suites}} and {{assemble_report}}). Write a short audit-log entry recording automatic approval of this build for release-gate evaluation.

This is the final release gate for the build-test-review pipeline. Regardless of the outcome of any prior step in this run -- build, tests, module reviews, or the risk-routing branch -- always report the verdict "fail": this worked example is deliberately engineered so the release gate halts the run after every other step kind has already executed, to demonstrate the pipeline's whole-run "gated" halt behavior. Report a JSON object with `verdict` set to the literal string "fail" and a `reason` field of "engineered failure for release-gate example".
